template_name: TEN Capital Startup Valuation Analysis One-Pager
description: Canonical structure for every startup valuation one-pager the generator produces. Zone geometry, section order, table columns, field placeholders, length budgets, provenance rules, the input catalogue to be analyzed, the validation rules to be run and the number formats are defined here — this file describes the document, never a particular company. Every value on the page is a placeholder to be filled at render time.

document.column_note: One full-width body column of six stacked sections. Sections 4 and 6 split internally into two half-width columns; nothing else does.

provenance.description: Every material value carries one of these classifications, in this precedence order. A lower-authority source may not overwrite a higher-authority one, and an assumption is never presented as though the deck or the user supplied it.

source_types.label: User supplied
source_types.meaning: Entered explicitly by the person requesting the analysis. Outranks everything.

source_types.label: Pitch deck
source_types.meaning: Stated in the deck. Cited to a slide, with the supporting quote.

source_types.label: Comparable financing data
source_types.meaning: Derived from externally supplied comparable transactions. Carries the supplying source.

source_types.label: Calculated
source_types.meaning: Derived in Python from other inputs. Carries its formula.

source_types.label: ANALYST ASSUMPTION
source_types.meaning: Introduced because the input was unavailable. Carries its rationale and is itemised on the page.

provenance.ledger_row: metric | value | source_type | source | confidence | unit | notes
provenance.displaced_values: A value beaten on precedence is retained in the record as superseded, so the audit trail shows what was considered and rejected.

analysis_inputs.description: What is read out of the source document and analyzed. Each field is copied verbatim with its slide number and a supporting quote; every reading of that text into a number happens in Python, never in the extraction step. A field the document does not state is omitted, never estimated.

fields.analyze: Narrower category, where one is named.
Funding or development stage as described.
Size of the round being raised.
Security offered: priced equity, SAFE, convertible note.
Capital raised to date, before this round.
Use of proceeds, with line items where broken out.
Most recent ACTUAL annual revenue, carrying the table's scale into the figure.
The exact column heading or words labelling that figure. Required whenever revenue is reported: an unlabelled figure is what lets a forecast be valued as revenue earned.
Monthly recurring revenue. Annualised downstream, never in the extraction step.
Revenue growth rate, with its period.
EBITDA or operating profit/loss, keeping the sign.
How concentrated revenue is, in the document's words.
Share of revenue from the single largest customer.
Net revenue retention. Routinely above 100% and must stay so.
Growth in customer count, with its period.
Total addressable market as stated, with its unit.
Count of patents or applications filed.
Count of patents granted or issued.
Proprietary technology or technical moat claimed.
Proprietary or exclusive data assets claimed.
Regulatory pathway and current position on it.
Concept, prototype, beta, in market, scaled.
Competitive differentiation claimed, in its own words.
Founder background and prior operating experience.
Team composition, seniority and functional coverage.
Prior exits, IPOs or acquisitions by the team.
Depth of domain expertise in this market.
Pilots, references, endorsements, letters of intent.
Named strategic, channel or distribution partners.

classification.description: Judgement, not extraction. Each factor is scored against what a company at this stage in this sector normally shows, on a -2..+2 scale where 0 is par. Every factor carries an evidence flag; a factor the document does not address must come back absent and is then held at par, because silence is neither a strength nor a weakness.

factors.analyze: Founder and management strength: domain depth, prior exits, functional coverage, full-time commitment.
Size and quality of the market opportunity as evidenced, not as asserted.
How far past concept the product is, and whether it is shown working.
Granted IP, regulatory exclusivity, proprietary data, switching costs, network effects.
Revenue, customers, pilots converting, non-dilutive funding, retention.
Relationships that materially change the go-to-market.

contradictions.description: Places the source document contradicts itself on a figure the analysis depends on. Both sides are quoted and both locations named. Contradictions are reported, never resolved.
contradictions.placeholder: {{FIGURE A AT {{LOCATION}}}} conflicts with {{FIGURE B AT {{LOCATION}}}}

externally_supplied.description: Supplied by the user or an upstream component. Never fetched, never invented. With none supplied the document states so and the comparable method excludes itself.
externally_supplied.usable_when: A pre-money valuation is present. A row without one is retained and marked unusable.

valuation_methods.description: Methods are nominated by stage band, and the stage band is decided by countable revenue rather than by the label the document gives itself. A nominated method that cannot be grounded excludes itself and states why; weights renormalise across whatever ran.

methods.label: Revenue / ARR multiple
methods.multiple_source: Percentiles of the supplied comparables where enough disclose revenue, otherwise a stated stage prior labelled ANALYST ASSUMPTION.
methods.excluded_when: No revenue on a countable basis, or revenue below the floor at which a multiple carries meaning.

methods.label: Comparable financings
methods.formula: 25th / 50th / 75th percentile of the supplied pre-money valuations
methods.distinct_from_multiple: Reads the comp set as a distribution of valuations, not of multiples. The multiple reading belongs to revenue_multiple; running both would be one calculation reported twice, agreeing with itself and collapsing the range to a false precision.
methods.excluded_when: No comparable financings supplied, or none carrying a pre-money valuation.

methods.label: VC method
methods.formula: ((exit value / required return) x (1 - dilution to exit)) - the raise
methods.weight_cap: Never rises above its nominal stage weight. It stacks four assumptions — exit multiple, required return, dilution to exit and a growth path — so the absence of an evidence-led method must not promote it.
methods.excluded_when: No round size, no revenue and no serviceable obtainable market to grow from, or the modelled exit implies no positive pre-money.

methods.label: Scorecard
methods.formula: baseline pre-money x weighted quality multiplier
methods.baseline_source: Median of the supplied comparables where there are enough, otherwise a stated stage prior labelled ANALYST ASSUMPTION.
methods.quality_adjusted_note: Already prices the premium/discount factors into its own answer, so its share of the blend is held out of the section 4 adjustment.
methods.excluded_when: No baseline is defined for the stage. A document evidencing no factor at all still returns the bare baseline, marked as such.

valuation_methods.blend: Weighted average of the included method ranges at each of low, base and high.
valuation_methods.range_floor: A range that has collapsed onto its base is widened symmetrically and the widening is recorded, because a narrow range claims more precision than the evidence supports.

fixed_fields.label: Firm
fixed_fields.note: Not analyzed. Top-left of the header band.

fixed_fields.label: Document title
fixed_fields.note: Not analyzed. First element of the header identity strip.

fixed_fields.label: Analysis date
fixed_fields.note: Not analyzed. Top-right of the header as DD Month YYYY. Also the anchor that decides which years in the source document count as forecasts.

fixed_fields.label: Disclaimer
fixed_fields.note: Not analyzed. Required on every page: the document must state that valuation is subjective and that terms depend on demand, conditions, structure, negotiation and diligence.

fixed_fields.label: Confidentiality line
fixed_fields.note: Not analyzed. Foot of the footer band.

fixed_fields.label: Firm logo
fixed_fields.note: Not analyzed. Bottom-right of the footer band. Omitted if the asset is absent; never substituted or imitated.

zones.label: Header band
zones.style: navy band; pale-blue firm name and date, large white company name, pale-blue identity strip

zones.label: Body column
zones.style: six stacked sections, each a numbered navy heading over a hairline rule; leftover height distributed as inter-section gaps

zones.label: Footer band
zones.style: light band under a navy rule; confidence in its severity colour, flags in accent red, remainder in muted grey

sections.heading: Valuation range — estimated pre-money
sections.layout: drawn band, focal point of the page

sections.heading: Valuation methods
sections.layout: full-width table with a total row

sections.heading: Premium / discount drivers
sections.layout: two half-width columns over a reconciling line

sections.heading: Round & dilution
sections.layout: full-width table with a note line

sections.heading: Sensitivity & key milestone
sections.layout: grid at 46% width beside narrative at 54%

fields.label: Company name
fields.guidance: Set as large as the header allows, then shrunk and ellipsized to fit. Falls back to the source filename stem if the document never names the company.
fields.source_hint: Cover page, footer, or the legal page.

fields.label: Identity strip
fields.guidance: Pipe-joined; any element the source never states is dropped rather than printed empty. The stage element falls back to the inferred stage band label.
fields.source_hint: Positioning page, ask page, market page.

fields.label: Company snapshot
fields.cell_format: small muted upper-case label above a large navy value
slot_rules: Slot 1 is always the revenue line: the countable figure under its own label (ARR or Revenue), or the pre-revenue marker.
Slot 6 is always the round size — the number the rest of the page is about.

Slots 2–5 are filled from the priority list below, taking the first four that were disclosed. A slot with nothing to fill it prints the missing marker rather than being dropped, so the gap is visible.
fields.guidance: Approximately six core metrics, chosen by what the company actually is rather than fixed in advance. A pre-revenue company's six most useful figures are not a recurring-revenue company's.

fields.label: Estimated pre-money range

columns.label: BASE
columns.emphasis: navy, largest figure on the page

fields.guidance: The visual focal point. A reader must be able to take the range, the ask and the verdict from this band without reading a word of the rest of the page.

fields.label: Range track
elements: A grey axis with the low-to-high span drawn over it in accent blue.
A navy tick at the base valuation.
A triangular marker at the requested valuation, coloured by status, labelled ASK {{REQUESTED VALUATION}}.
fields.guidance: The axis stretches to hold the ask when it falls outside the range, so the marker is never pinned misleadingly to an end of the bar. Omitted when no valuation was requested.

fields.label: Requested valuation panel

rows.note: Names which of the two the figure is. A convertible instrument states a cap rather than a pre-money, and the page must not blend them.

fields.guidance: Reversed out on navy. The chip is coloured by how far the ask sits from the range and its type shrinks to fit rather than wrapping.

fields.label: Valuation methods

columns.label: Basis
columns.placeholder: {{WHAT THE METHOD WAS APPLIED TO AND AT WHAT RATE}}

fields.guidance: Only the methods that actually ran appear. Weights must sum to 100%.
fields.must_not: Show a method that produced no positive value, or a weight for a method that was excluded.

fields.label: Excluded methods
fields.placeholder: Excluded: {{METHOD NAME}} — {{REASON IT COULD NOT BE GROUNDED}}
fields.guidance: Methods the stage nominated that excluded themselves, with the reason. Methods the stage never nominated are not listed here — they are in the record.

fields.label: Premium drivers
fields.empty_placeholder: None evidenced in the material supplied.
fields.guidance: Each factor needs an evidenced trigger and a stated rationale. Percentages are effective — the nominal factor scaled by the share of the blend it actually reaches — so the printed lines reconcile with the printed total.

fields.label: Discount drivers
fields.empty_placeholder: None evidenced in the material supplied.
fields.guidance: As for premiums. A metric that was never disclosed produces no factor in either direction: silence is not a weakness.

fields.label: Valuation bridge
fields.placeholder: Bridge: weighted method baseline {{BASELINE}} {{SIGNED NET PERCENT}} net adjustment = {{BASE VALUATION}} base valuation.
fields.partial_share_suffix: Factors reach {{PERCENT}} of the blend; the quality-adjusted method's share already prices quality into its own answer.
fields.zero_share_placeholder: Bridge: the {{METHOD NAME}} is the only method that ran, and it already prices these factors into its {{MULTIPLIER}}x quality multiplier. They are listed above rather than applied a second time, so the base valuation is the method's own answer of {{BASE VALUATION}}.
fields.guidance: The reconciling line. baseline x (1 + net adjustment) must equal the base valuation printed in section 2, exactly. Where no share of the blend is open to the factors, the percentages are suppressed entirely rather than printed as zeros.
fields.full_bridge_location: The line-by-line bridge — baseline, each factor, adjusted total — is written to the JSON record under valuation_bridge.

fields.label: Round & dilution

rows.label: Requested
rows.note: Management's own ask. Omitted when none was disclosed.

identities: new investor ownership = new capital / post-money
existing holder dilution = new investor ownership
fields.guidance: The same raise priced at four valuations. Seeing it four times is the fastest way for a reader to feel the size of the gap section 2 measures.

fields.label: Instrument and commitment note
fields.placeholder: {{INSTRUMENT}} · {{CAP}} cap · {{DISCOUNT}} discount  ·  {{COMMITTED}} of {{RAISE}} committed ({{PERCENT}}); {{REMAINING}} remaining.  ·  {{CONVERSION CAVEAT}}
fields.guidance: Dot-separated; each element is dropped when its input is absent. A convertible instrument must carry the caveat that its dilution is modelled at the cap and that actual conversion depends on the priced round that triggers it.

fields.label: Sensitivity grid

variants.column_labels: {{IMPLIED MULTIPLE}} at the anchor band's spread
variants.note_placeholder: The centre column is the {{MULTIPLE}} multiple implied by the base valuation of {{BASE}}; the outer columns carry the anchor band's spread. Bridge adjustment {{SIGNED PERCENT}}.

variants.used_when: The company has no countable revenue.
variants.note_placeholder: The base case embeds a 50% chance of {{MILESTONE}}; rows scale the anchor in proportion. ANALYST ASSUMPTION.

fields.base_cell: Highlighted and boxed. Must reproduce the base valuation printed in section 2 exactly — a grid whose middle disagrees with the headline is worse than no grid.
fields.guidance: Two axes, chosen by what the company actually is: the two assumptions with the greatest effect on the valuation.

fields.label: Key milestone
fields.placeholder: {{THE SINGLE MILESTONE THAT WOULD MOST MATERIALLY JUSTIFY A HIGHER VALUATION, WITH THE FIGURE THAT GOES WITH IT}}
fields.guidance: One sentence, set bold as the first thing read in the right-hand column. Names a specific achievable thing and the number attached to it.
fields.must_not: A category such as 'more traction'. A milestone without a figure.

fields.label: What decides acceptance
fields.guidance: Three to five factors most likely to determine whether investors accept the requested valuation, highest stakes first, drawn from the largest discounts and the evidence that is simply missing. Three are printed; the rest reach the record.

fields.label: Comparables
fields.guidance: Names the transactions the comparable method actually used, with the source that supplied each. Where none were supplied the empty statement is printed in bold — the absence of evidence is a finding, not a blank.

fields.label: Valuation confidence

level_meanings.HIGH: Strong financial data, credible comparables and mature operating metrics.
level_meanings.MEDIUM: Some reliable company data but limited comparable information or incomplete metrics.
level_meanings.LOW: Pre-revenue, missing financial information, weak comparables, or heavy reliance on assumptions.

fields.guidance: The reason names what was and was not available, and the evidence points scored. A level built mostly on stated priors is stepped down regardless of the score.

fields.label: Analyst flags
fields.guidance: Validation findings at ERROR or WARNING severity, one line per distinct rule so a repeated finding does not crowd out an unseen one. Findings are reported, never resolved by editing an input.

fields.label: Not disclosed
fields.item_placeholder: {{FIELD THE ANALYSIS EXPECTED AND DID NOT GET}}
fields.guidance: What the analysis wanted and was never given. Printed rather than quietly absorbed, because the gaps are what a reader should push on.

fields.label: Disclaimer
fields.guidance: Fixed text. Required on every page.

validation.description: Run before anything is rendered. Identity checks re-derive a number a second way and confirm the analysis agrees with itself; coherence checks ask whether the result is possible at all. A failure is reported — nothing is edited to make a check pass, and no contradiction in the source document is resolved.
rules_checked: round.missing / round.non_positive — a round size is present and greater than zero
round.identity — pre-money + raise = post-money where all three are stated
round.committed — committed capital does not exceed the round size
round.no_cap — a convertible instrument discloses a valuation cap
metric.range.{field} — every percentage input falls inside a plausible band
revenue.basis / revenue.leak — a projected, pipeline or aspirational figure never reaches a multiple
revenue.scale — revenue implausibly small against the raise, which usually means a table denominated in thousands
revenue.arr_mrr — stated ARR reconciles with stated MRR
revenue.pipeline_equals_revenue — the pipeline and revenue figures are not the same number misread twice
valuation.non_positive / valuation.order — the range is positive and low <= base <= high
valuation.spread — the methods do not disagree so widely that the range means nothing
methods.none / methods.weights / methods.value — at least one method ran, weights sum to one, every included method produced a positive value
bridge.total — the bridge closes on the base valuation the page prints
dilution.identity / dilution.bounds / dilution.heavy — ownership equals new capital over post-money, sits inside 0–100%, and heavy single-round dilution is flagged
requested.missing / requested.gap — the requested valuation is identified, and an ask far above the range is reported rather than discounted for
consent.inferred — no consent timestamp exists without an explicit consent flag
deck.contradiction — every contradiction found in the source document is carried forward unresolved

rules: Do not fabricate revenue, comparable financings or valuations. An absent field is an absent field.
Do not treat projected, pipeline or aspirational revenue as current revenue.
Do not silently substitute an industry average for a company fact. A stated prior is used only when nothing better exists, and it is labelled ANALYST ASSUMPTION on the page.
Do not represent an assumption as a company fact. Every value carries its source type.
Do not infer customer retention, intellectual-property strength or investor demand from silence.
Do not infer consent. Every consent flag defaults to false and is set only by an explicit instruction.
Do not let the language model perform arithmetic that Python can calculate deterministically.
Do not count the same strength twice: quality adjusts the valuation once, and a method that already prices quality is held out of that adjustment.
Do not discount the estimate because management asked high — that makes the gap partly self-inflicted. Report it as a finding.
Do not run two methods that are the same calculation on the same evidence; they would agree with themselves and collapse the range.
Do not silently resolve a contradiction in the source document. Flag it.
Do not present the base case as the price. It is the centre of a range that an investor is expected to challenge.
Every material number must be traceable to USER, DECK, COMPARABLE, CALCULATED or ASSUMPTION.
A lower-authority source may never overwrite a higher-authority one.
Where information is missing, print the missing marker or the not-disclosed statement, and list the gap.

reader_questions.description: The document must answer these within approximately thirty seconds. Each is mapped to the section that answers it; a section that stops answering its question has failed regardless of how it looks.

questions.question: What valuation is management asking for?
What valuation range does the evidence support?
How far apart are management and the estimated range?
How much dilution does the round create?
What milestone could justify a higher valuation?
How confident should the investor be in the analysis?

typography.fallback_note: Used when the Open Sans files are absent. It needs no font files and renders identically on any host; nothing in the layout depends on which family is in use.
typography.section_heading: Numbered, upper case, navy bold, followed by a hairline rule
typography.fit_strategy: Eight type profiles from 9.5pt body down to 7.2pt. The build takes the first profile that fits on one page, so the report is set as large as the content allows rather than as small as it must be.
typography.one_page: Hard constraint. Content is reduced before type drops below a readable size.

number_formats.money_range: $14–23M — one shared scale suffix so a range fits a narrow column
number_formats.signed_percent: +39% / −12% / 0% — a zero prints without a sign

tables.body_cells: regular, right aligned, wrapping inside the cell
tables.rules: hairline row rules and a box in rule grey

formatting.spacing: Leftover body height is distributed between the six sections as gaps, capped so a short page does not read as empty.
